newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian newspaper appears after six-month ban.
newsitem.headline: Algerian newspaper appears after six-month ban.

text.p: The Algerian French-language newspaper La Tribune reappeared on news-stands on Tuesday after a six-month suspension over a cartoon deemed by the authorities as mocking the Algerian flag, newspaper staff said.

The paper reappeared as Algeria's journalists remembered on Tuesday two journalists killed a year ago in a car bomb attack outside Algiers's Press House where the country's leading newspapers have offices.
Algerian media have been caught in the four-year-old civil strife between the authorities and Moslem guerrillas.
More than 50 journalists have been killed since 1993 when Moslem rebels began targeting journalists whom they accused of siding with the government they are trying to topple.
